description: Check a business name before you commit to it. Lovie searches live US trademarks at the USPTO and looks up domain availability across .com, .io, .co, .net, .ai and .app, then tells you what it found — the closest live marks with their serial numbers and goods, and which domains are already taken. It can also brainstorm name candidates for your business and screen your favourites. Results are a preliminary screen, not legal clearance. No account, no sign-in, nothing to install.
